name: Fabric Factory Lab
product_goal: Teach visual Microsoft Fabric/Data Factory pipeline orchestration and Mapping Data Flow concepts while executing useful local data work for real on DuckDB/DuckLake.

fabric_semantic_backend.future_role: Keep Fabric/Data Factory semantics and API contracts; become adapter/control layer rather than a duplicate general ETL executor.

verified_capabilities: DuckDB execution engine with topological graph execution
generated readable SQL / plan per node
DuckLake sources and sinks, including CDC and time-travel-related components
per-node status, row counts, timings and previews
control-flow nodes including foreach, switch, wait, try/fallback and child-pipeline execution
duckle_external_foundation.architecture_truth: Duckle is not Microsoft Fabric and is not Airflow. It is a real local/self-hosted ETL/ELT engine and visual pipeline product built on DuckDB.
duckle_external_foundation.decision: Primary lower-layer candidate. Run an integration/fork spike before writing any new generic FactoryLab executor.

major_surfaces: Pipeline Studio: Fabric/Data Factory orchestration/control-flow UX
Mapping Data Flow Studio: row/data transformations
target_state.graph_rule: React Flow is the common rendering technology, but Fabric pipelines, Mapping Data Flows and Airflow DAGs keep separate domain models and semantics.
layered_architecture: Fabric/ADF React UI and learning semantics
DuckDB/DuckLake physical execution and data state
fabric_to_duckle_translation_targets: SqlScript -> Duckle SQL/code node with explicit DuckDB truth label
Data Flow Source/Select/Derived Column/Filter/Aggregate/Join/Conditional Split/Lookup/Union/Sink -> Duckle graph components where semantics match
quality checks -> Duckle qa.* components where semantics match
ForEach/Switch/Wait/child pipeline -> Duckle ctl.* where semantics match
Notebook -> separate notebook executor/adaptor unless a reviewed Duckle code runner is an exact semantic fit
fastapi_fabric_retained_responsibilities: ADF/Fabric parameters, variables and dynamic-expression teaching
truth labels distinguishing Fabric, Duckle, DuckDB and simulation
translation from FactoryLab IR to Duckle pipeline documents
normalizing Duckle run evidence for the FactoryLab UI
duckle_execution_responsibilities: optional run history/scheduling when FactoryLab elects Duckle as scheduler of record
ducklake_differentiator: surface Duckle/DuckLake source and sink behavior
mapping_data_flow_learning: Source Settings / Source Options / Projection / Optimize / Inspect / Data Preview style learning surface
real Data Preview from translated partial-flow execution
schema propagation/Inspect backed by real plan/schema evidence when possible
partition options taught honestly: Duckle/DuckDB behavior is not mislabeled as Fabric Spark partition execution
target_state.dbt_boundary: FactoryLab may invoke dbt as a pipeline activity through Duckle or an adapter, but full dbt project authoring/modeling ownership remains Contoso.
target_state.scheduler_rule: Choose one scheduler of record for a deployment. If Duckle schedules a pipeline, do not also let an external Airflow scheduler own the same cadence.

airflow_boundary.rule: FactoryLab does not become an Airflow simulator. Airflow is Python-first orchestration and remains a CaseLab teaching/runtime concern.
airflow_boundary.allowed_integration: Later expose an interoperability lesson or export/operator that runs a Duckle/FactoryLab pipeline from Airflow. Duckle documents CLI and HTTP orchestration from Airflow but currently ships no official Airflow provider package.

fork_strategy.rationale: Our Fabric/ADF donor UI is already product-specific. Duckle already supplies the expensive lower layer. Wrapping its stable pipeline/runner interfaces avoids maintaining a large divergent fork while preserving Fabric semantics.
required_spike: Map a small FactoryLab pipeline to Duckle pipeline JSON
execute it through duckle-runner or server API
test DuckLake source/sink and one control-flow node
measure what Fabric semantics cannot be represented without an adapter
fork_strategy.fork_trigger: Fork Duckle only if adapter boundaries prevent required educational UX or evidence access. Do not write a greenfield executor before this spike.

scope_boundary.not_airflow: FactoryLab teaches visual Data Factory/Fabric orchestration, not Python-first Airflow scheduling.
scope_boundary.not_contoso: FactoryLab consumes/moves/transforms data; Contoso owns the broader analytics/data-platform model.
scope_boundary.not_datapass: FactoryLab is not a LeetCode/coding drill product.

next_assembly_step: Run the Duckle integration spike first; then assign a standalone FactoryLab frontend repo and assemble the existing Fabric donor UI over fastapi-fabric + Duckle instead of implementing a new generic executor.
